label: prf:descartes-elliptic-curve
title: Proof of descartes elliptic curve
html:
Proof. Proof of descartes elliptic curve

Proof. The color elliptic curve (color elliptic) at spacetime ratio z is X^3 + (z + 1)X^2 + (z^2 + z + 1)X + (z^3 + z^2 + z + 1) = 0. The Weierstrass normal form is obtained by the standard shift X = x - (z + 1)/3, giving y^2 = x^3 + p(z)x + r(z) with p(z) = \tfrac{2}{3}z^2 + \tfrac{1}{3}z + \tfrac{2}{3} and r(z) = \tfrac{20}{27}z^3 + \tfrac{5}{9}z^2 + \tfrac{5}{9}z + \tfrac{20}{27}. Substituting z = s - s^{-1} with s = \sqrt{q} and simplifying (multiply through by s^2 resp. s^3 to clear denominators, then factor) yields the stated formula. The factor (s^2 + s - 1) in s^3 r(s) is verified by direct expansion. \square
